sentences.text: 3. The charge sheet dated 25.12.2017 was submitted alleging commission of offences under Sections 376- D, 506, 323 I.P.C.
The offence under Section 376-D I.P.C is cognizable by a Court of Session only and the Judicial Magistrate has to commit the case to a Court of Session upon appearance of the accused.
However, as the accused persons have not appeared before the Magistrate till date, the case could not be committed to the Session Court.
4. The learned A.G.A has opposed the application and has submitted that the case relates to offences under sections 376-D, 323 and 506 I.P.C which is triable by a Court of Session only.
The Magistrate cannot proceed with the trial of the case and he cannot decide the same.

sentences.text: As the case is pending before the Judicial Magistrate since 31.05.2018 and it could not be committed to the Session Court for want of appearance of the accused in spite of warrants having been issued repetitively, the S.H.O of Police Station Fakherpur, Distirct Bahraich is directed to ensure appearance of the accused person by executing the warrant within a period of one month from today.
Upon appearance of the accused, the Judicial Magistrate, Bahraich will forthwith commit the case to the Session Court.
6. Accordingly, the instant application is disposed of.
